top_signals.title: Schmid Says Fed Has Work to Do on Inflation
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City President Jeff Schmid says the Fed hasn't fulfilled its promise on the inflation side of its mandate at the Richmond Fed's Investing in Rural America conference. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Why Bond Yields Are Climbing All Over the World (Video)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Ben Affleck on AI and Hollywood Economics
top_signals.summary: Artists Equity CEO Ben Affleck discusses current Hollywood economics, artist-focused business models and AI's role in the industry with Bloomberg’s Lucas Shaw at Bloomberg Screentime 2026 in Los Angeles. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Bond Traders Lash Out at BofA, Citi as Paramount’s Debt Craters
top_signals.summary: Just hours after Paramount Skydance Corp. issued $52 billion of debt to fund the biggest Hollywood buyout ever, investors were nursing hundreds of millions of dollars in losses, triggering a flurry of angry calls from money managers to Wall Street banks that underwrote the debt.

top_signals.title: ‘The world of Cat TV is more cut throat than you would ever imagine’ – inside the strange business of TV… for cats
top_signals.summary: On the internet, no one knows you’re a cat.
